cards.card_text: It comes from when Nathan the prophet came to David after his adultery with Bathsheba, the wife of Uriah the Hittite (2 Samuel 11:3).

cards.card_text: Then the teacher turns from the thief to the man who commits adultery.
cards.verse_text: He who commits adultery lacks judgment; whoever does so destroys himself.

cards.card_text: Because faithless Israel committed adultery, what did God give her before sending her away?
cards.verse_text: She saw that because faithless Israel had committed adultery, I gave her a certificate of divorce and sent her away.
cards.snippet: She saw that because faithless Israel had committed adultery, I gave her a certificate of divorce and sent her away.

cards.card_text: And Israel, indifferent to her own infidelity, had defiled the land and committed adultery with stones and trees.

cards.snippet: She saw that because faithless Israel had committed adultery, I gave her a certificate of divorce and sent her away.

cards.snippet: I satisfied their needs, yet they committed adultery and assembled at the houses of prostitutes.

cards.card_text: Then He names their adulteries and lustful neighings, their shameless prostitution on the hills and in the fields.

cards.card_text: The LORD says they have committed an outrage in Israel: adultery with their neighbors' wives, and lies in His name that He did not command.

cards.card_text: God sentences Jerusalem to the punishment of women who commit adultery and those who shed blood.

cards.card_text: But God says the sisters will be sentenced to the punishment for adultery and bloodshed.

cards.card_text: He tells Hosea to go, take a prostitute as his wife and have children of adultery.
cards.verse_text: When the LORD first spoke through Hosea, He told him, “Go, take a prostitute as your wife and have children of adultery, because this land is flagrantly prostituting itself by departing from the LORD.”

cards.card_text: Cursing and lying, murder and stealing, and adultery are rampant.

cards.snippet: You have heard that it was said, ‘Do not commit adultery.’

cards.verse_text: But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
cards.snippet: …who looks at a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

cards.card_text: Jesus says anyone who divorces his wife brings adultery upon her, with one exception.
cards.verse_text: But I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, brings adultery upon her.

cards.card_text: And Jesus adds that he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.

cards.verse_text: Now I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman commits adultery.”

cards.card_text: Jesus starts listing: don't murder, don't commit adultery, don't steal, don't bear false witness, honor your father and mother.
cards.verse_text: Jesus answered, “‘Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness, honor your father and mother, and love your neighbor as yourself.’”

cards.card_text: Then Jesus lists what comes out: evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery, greed, wickedness, deceit, debauchery, envy, slander, arrogance and foolishness.
cards.verse_text: For from within the hearts of men come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery, greed, wickedness, deceit, debauchery, envy, slander, arrogance, and foolishness.
cards.snippet: …within the hearts of men come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery, greed, wickedness, deceit, debauchery, envy, slander, arrogance, and foolishness.

cards.card_text: Jesus tells His disciples, "Whoever divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her." I think this one hits close to home for a lot of people.
cards.verse_text: So He told them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.
cards.snippet: …He told them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.

cards.card_text: If she divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.
cards.verse_text: And if a woman divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.”
cards.snippet: …if a woman divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.”

cards.card_text: Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery.

cards.snippet: Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery, and he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.

cards.card_text: Then Paul lists commandments: “Do not commit adultery,” “Do not murder,” “Do not steal,” “Do not covet,” and any other commandments.
cards.verse_text: The commandments “Do not commit adultery,” “Do not murder,” “Do not steal,” “Do not covet,” and any other commandments, are summed up in this one decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”

cards.verse_text: Behold, I will cast her onto a bed of sickness, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer great tribulation unless they repent of her deeds.
